description: A transparent, evidence-aware roadmap reviewed against the released application through v0.28.0. Delivered records implementation milestones, including successive expansions; it is not a count of independent features or scholarly certification. Future work has completion criteria and no promised delivery dates.
currentFocus: Next priority: manual screen-reader and real-device accessibility review

Continue citation remediation: 108 of 115 explained pairs now have dated assessments. The latest twenty prayer, faith, hope and Hezekiah comparisons have paired contexts and scoped named commentary. The other 7 pairs and fuller literature remain open.
Keep desktop/mobile browser, accessibility and notebook regression checks passing in CI; add manual assistive-technology findings as they are reviewed
Arrange independent historical, textual and archaeological review, including the first Exodus collection, when suitable specialists are available
Then extend the Hebrew Bible geography library with separately scoped kings, prophets, exile and return studies

milestones.title: Bible reading and personal study
milestones.summary: The 66-book navigator, ESV reader, verse search, bookmarks, local notes and reading history form the foundation.
capabilities: All 66 books and chapter navigation
Official Crossway ESV text via server-side API
Bookmarks, private local notes and recent reading
milestones.verification: Available in the live application; text retrieval depends on the Crossway service and applicable licensing.

milestones.title: Ten-hop Connection Atlas
milestones.summary: Explore Scripture connections using curated notes and attributed OpenBible.info cross-references, without treating community vote scores as scholarly confidence.
capabilities: Up to 10 reference hops with bounded rendering
Book / chapter / verse selection and per-verse Atlas actions
603,076 directed reference links imported from 344,753 valid non-self OpenBible.info source rows
milestones.verification: Dataset importer and CI checks validate reference structure and provenance, not the exegetical validity of each connection. Seven bars are normalised source scores relative to the selected verse, not academic confidence ratings.

milestones.title: Guided study journeys
milestones.summary: Six theme-based entry points and deep links into Scripture.
capabilities: Six curated journeys
Reader links and study notes
milestones.verification: Curated paths are tested for valid Bible references.

milestones.title: Journeys of Jesus
milestones.summary: A self-hosted geographic itinerary following Gospel and Acts passages without drawing invented historical roads.
capabilities: 79 episode entries and 35 places or regions
Interactive pins, repeated visit lists and draggable timeline
Passage links, location confidence and qualified route reconstruction
milestones.verification: Narrative sequence is an editorial harmonisation and not a complete historically dated itinerary.

milestones.title: Place history and archaeology panels
milestones.summary: Historical context for each of the 35 journey markers, while distinguishing scriptural claims from external scholarship.
capabilities: Ancient and modern names and location context
Archaeology summaries with source links where available
Old Testament historical connections and Gospel episode index
milestones.verification: All 35 places have a dossier; depth of independent archaeological references varies by place.

milestones.title: Production platform and automated builds
milestones.summary: The public site is deployed from private GitHub source to Cloudflare Pages, with server-side Bible retrieval and automated source/data checks.
capabilities: Production branch builds from the private GitHub repository
Automated Node tests, data validation and Pages Functions
Bible-provider credentials remain server-side; licensed text is retrieved on demand
milestones.verification: Production deployment and source checks are verified per release. Browser end-to-end and accessibility automation remain a separate planned milestone.

milestones.title: Gospel journey audit - initial editorial pass
milestones.summary: All 79 episode entries and 35 place dossiers now have traceable screening states, a publicly visible corrections register, and open historical questions.
capabilities: Passage-reference syntax and Gospel/Acts scope checks
Corrected Capernaum, Jairus lakeshore, Caesarea Philippi district, Bethphage and supper summaries
Published correction history, evidence categories and chronology concerns
Explicitly report unresolved research issues without attached independent secondary-source links
milestones.verification: Initial AI-assisted screening, provenance checks and dated academic bibliography links are documented. Missing secondary citations remain visible. No independent external peer review has occurred.

milestones.title: Five deep historical city studies
milestones.summary: Five browsable studies of Jerusalem, Nazareth, Capernaum, Bethlehem and Jericho, each with source-linked biblical history, chronology and archaeological qualification, plus contested identification comparisons.
capabilities: Five dedicated, independently selectable city pages using one reusable design
40 primary Scripture links, 25 historical period summaries, 20 individually source-qualified findings
Modern site photo licensing and source attribution with illustrative site-orientation maps
Comparative location studies for Cana, Bethsaida and Emmaus
Direct navigation from Journeys of Jesus and to Bible Reader or Connection Atlas
milestones.verification: Implementation, data schema and citations tested. The studies are sourced editorial summaries, not externally peer-reviewed archaeological monographs; coordinate markers are approximations and the photo gallery depicts modern sites.

milestones.title: Gospel chronology comparison
milestones.summary: Compare the order in which the four Gospel texts present the catalogued Jesus-journey episodes, alongside the combined editorial study sequence.
capabilities: Independent Matthew, Mark, Luke and John textual-order selectors based on each account's cited passages
Chronology and possible-parallel notes for disputed Nazareth, temple, Bethany and disciple-call passages
Original Scripture references and linked academic reading, with no invented calendar dates or physical journeys
milestones.verification: Textual sequence follows chapter and verse ordering within each Gospel, not established event dates. Dataset and issue links are validated in automated tests. Full source-critical synoptic comparison and external scholarly review remain outstanding.

milestones.title: Explain sourced Scripture connections
milestones.summary: Introduced selective passage-by-passage evidence categories in the Atlas, without implying the complete OpenBible archive is classified.
capabilities: 24 selected passage comparisons spanning quotations, narrative parallels, literary echoes, interpretive typology and shared themes
Each annotated connection includes a context passage and interpretation caution
Filters separate explained and unclassified links while preserving OpenBible vote bars
People Index profiles surface related Atlas paths for overlapping cited passages
milestones.verification: Canonical passage references and pair identity are checked in CI. These are internal editorial passage comparisons, not independent specialist certification. The OpenBible corpus stays unclassified by default.

milestones.title: People, places and events index
milestones.summary: A cross-linked Gospel knowledge index with disambiguated people, all 35 mapped places and all 79 recorded journey events.
capabilities: Curated biblical person profiles with cited passages, alternate names and disambiguation
Reusable 35-place dossiers and associated archaeology sources, all 79 Gospel journey events
Search by name, aliases, reference or narrative, with deep links to the reader, Atlas, journey map and city studies
Evidence-status warnings and source limitations preserved across links
milestones.verification: Indexed IDs, relationship targets and cited passage boundaries are checked in CI. Profiles rely on the Gospel text as primary narrative testimony; the curated people list is intentionally incomplete and has not received independent specialist peer review.

milestones.title: Expand the biblical people, places and events index
milestones.summary: Expanded the local people and events index into the Hebrew Bible and added further named biblical figures across both Testaments, with discoverable featured entries and improved category guidance.
capabilities: Disambiguated Old Testament figures including monarchs, prophets and similarly named individuals
Narrative events from ancestral traditions to the Persian-era return, with relevant people and places linked
Distinct political realms and ancient locations without invented map pins or timeless borders
Selected museum references about Assyrian inscriptions, Lachish reliefs, Babylonian inscriptions and the Cyrus Cylinder
Featured people and kingdoms are directly discoverable without browsing multiple result pages
milestones.verification: Biblical addresses, related entities, museum-source identifiers and disambiguations are validated in CI. Only historical statements specifically attested by an external source are attributed to it. No claim of independent peer review or complete Old Testament coverage.

milestones.title: Switch reader translations
milestones.summary: Read the same verse, range or chapter in ESV, NASB20, NIV (2011) or NKJV without leaving Scripture Trails.
capabilities: Translation selector with saved device preference and shareable edition links
NASB20, NIV and NKJV through a server-side API.Bible integration
Publisher attribution and API.Bible Scripture-view reporting
Translation-neutral Atlas actions retained in every reader edition
milestones.verification: Production verse and full-chapter requests for NASB20, NIV and NKJV verified on 27 October 2026, including returned copyright notices and Scripture-view tokens. ESV retrieval, 56 automated tests, Cloudflare runtime request settings and desktop/mobile browser checks also passed.

milestones.title: Original-language study
milestones.summary: Research separately licensed Hebrew and Greek lexical, morphology and textual-study resources after the existing four-edition reader; define a useful first study tool before implementation.
capabilities: Identify licensed Hebrew and Greek lexical datasets
Compare variant renderings only where permissions allow
Carefully sourced original-language study tools
milestones.verification: Research gate: identify usable datasets, redistribution rights, attribution, versification and a maintainable technical scope before committing implementation. No additional copyrighted text may be hosted without permission.

milestones.title: Richer notes, exports and reading plans
milestones.summary: Linked observations, place links, highlights, notebook backups and optional passage schedules now form a private study workspace.
capabilities: Notes linked to multiple verses and places
Export and import personal work with clear privacy notices
Reading goals and optional progress tracking
milestones.verification: Local storage, reference and place validation, backup compatibility, merge conflicts and reading schedules are tested. No account or sync is required.

milestones.title: Optional encrypted sync and accounts
milestones.summary: Consider private device sync only after a clear privacy/security design and an actual user need.
capabilities: Opt-in login rather than a sign-up gate
Secure note synchronisation and deletion tools
Privacy policy and encrypted data handling
milestones.verification: Exploratory and not committed. Proceed only after a demonstrated cross-device need and documented threat model, encryption/key recovery, conflict handling, export/deletion and operating-cost decisions. Existing local study tools and backups are delivered.

milestones.title: Kings, prophets and wider historical geography
milestones.summary: After the first Hebrew Bible geography collection, add separately scoped studies of the monarchy, prophets, exile and return where sources support useful comparisons.
capabilities: Choose one historically bounded collection at a time, extending the existing people and event index
Compare changing realms, date models and disputed places with attributed sources
Provide passage-linked accessible lists and maps only where geographic evidence permits
milestones.verification: Depends on the first Hebrew Bible geography milestone. Complete each collection only after its own source, chronology and geographic-uncertainty audit; no timeless borders or unsupported coordinates.

milestones.title: Locally stored reference data and supporting assets
milestones.summary: The original OpenBible.info archive and all 66 generated Atlas files are stored with the project. Five credited city photographs are also served locally.
capabilities: 344799 source reference rows, with 344753 valid non-self rows imported
603076 directed navigation links across 66 book files
Source and generated-file checksums, provenance and attribution
Offline dataset regeneration with no reference download during builds
Local history, geography, verse metadata and city photographs
milestones.verification: All source reference pairs match an official OpenBible download. Vote counts differ by snapshot date. The original archive is retained unchanged, generated-file checksums are validated during builds, and publisher Bible APIs remain separate.

milestones.title: Deep Scripture connections and comparison
milestones.summary: Expanded passage-anchored comparisons, added paired Bible reading from official translation APIs, and introduced study trails for key biblical figures.
capabilities: 115 editorial passage-pair comparisons, including quotations, echoes, shared themes and parallel accounts, each with explicit review status
Side-by-side passage reader with selected Bible edition, individual publisher attributions and API.Bible usage reporting
Eight original person-centred reading trails (now expanded in a separate milestone) with Scripture passages, Atlas navigation and linked comparison actions
Provenance labels distinguish the original 24 context-screened records from 91 additional editorial reading aids; unclassified community links retain vote bars
milestones.verification: Release tests validate 115 unique pairs, reference boundaries, review classifications, and trail citations. Independent specialist review is not claimed and translations remain publisher-API dependent.

milestones.title: Journeys of Paul
milestones.summary: Explore 61 passage-linked narrative stages in Acts 13-21 with 33 approximate markers, repeat visits and explicit unpinned regional, unnamed and offshore stages.
capabilities: Three journey filters, an all-journeys view, timeline, playback, pan/zoom and a complete keyboard-accessible stage list
Reader and Atlas actions, Paul's index profile and related passage search
Pinned, locally retained Pleiades location sources and public-domain coastal orientation
Public location, narrative and textual uncertainty register without invented dates, roads or regional pins
milestones.verification: Canonical references, source-point alignment and narrative connector gaps are tested. The itinerary is an editorial reading aid, not externally peer-reviewed historical reconstruction. Island positions indicate island-scale orientation.

milestones.title: Paul's voyage to Rome
milestones.summary: A separately selectable prisoner voyage with 22 passage-linked stages in Acts 27-28, approximate named-place markers and unpinned offshore, storm and wreck settings.
capabilities: Passage-linked sailing stages and wintering locations
Explicitly uncertain or unlocated sea positions
Separate source and textual audit before adding new markers
milestones.verification: References and sourced marker alignment tested. No exact wreck bay, storm track or daily ship positions are claimed. Independent specialist review remains outstanding.

milestones.title: Private notebook export and import
milestones.summary: Download a versioned JSON backup of saved passages and notes; preview additions, duplicates and note conflicts before importing.
capabilities: Local file processing without an account or file upload
Preserve existing notes by default, with individual replacement choices
Validate references, file size and schema; reject unsupported files
Single-write notebook persistence with storage failure and stale-import handling
milestones.verification: Automated validation and merge tests plus browser round-trip checks. Backups are unencrypted and should be kept private. No publisher Bible text is fetched for export.

milestones.title: Optional study journey reading progress
milestones.summary: Track completed passages in the six existing guided study journeys and resume the next unread passage.
capabilities: Explicit per-passage checklists and completion indicators
Resume the next unread passage and confirm before resetting a plan
Local progress saved without an account
Version 2 notebook backups include progress; older backups remain supported
milestones.verification: Plan-reference validation, completion merge and backup compatibility tested. Progress is self-reported and does not measure reading time or comprehension. Structured annotations and calendar-based schedules are now delivered in separate milestones.

milestones.title: Linked observations and verse highlights
milestones.summary: Save tagged observations linked to multiple passages and colour-labelled, verse-reference highlights across reader editions.
capabilities: Linked note creation, editing and confirmed deletion in My notebook
Amber, green and blue highlights with visible text labels
Filter linked notes and highlights by passage, text, tag or highlight colour
Version 3 backups preserve annotations; version 1 and 2 imports remain supported with conflict previews
milestones.verification: Reference validation, merge conflicts and old-backup preservation tested. Reader highlight boundaries and translation switching tested with fixture text. Reference numbering may differ between editions; word-selection highlighting is not implemented.

milestones.title: Custom study collections and reading schedules
milestones.summary: Create ordered passage collections, optionally schedule one passage per selected reading day, and track progress locally.
capabilities: Build from six guided studies or enter custom passages
Choose a start date and reading weekdays, with fixed dates and explicit completion
Edit collections, resume reading and confirm deletion
Version 4 notebook backups retain collections and schedules, supporting versions 1 to 3
milestones.verification: Date boundaries, reference validation, backup compatibility, conflicts and storage failures tested. Dates use the device calendar. No reminders or automatic completion.

milestones.title: Place-linked observations and notebook organisation
milestones.summary: Connect private observations to existing places and regions, then move between the notebook and source-qualified place profiles.
capabilities: Link a note to passages, up to 20 indexed places, or both
Filter annotations by place, note type, tag, passage, text or highlight colour
Open private notes from a place profile without discarding the current draft
Version 5 notebook backups include place links and retain support for versions 1 to 4
milestones.verification: The 49-place registry is checked against the existing Gospel and Hebrew Bible source indexes. Notes are private user observations, not geographic evidence. Backup conflicts include changed place links; storage failures and stale writes are tested.

milestones.title: Further person-centred Scripture trails
milestones.summary: Twenty person-centred trails now include twelve further figures and a searchable directory, with explicit primary-passage and editorial review labels.
capabilities: Twenty disambiguated profiles: the original eight plus twelve additional figures
Eighty-eight selected Scripture readings, including forty-eight additional contextual ranges
Search by name, passage or topic and filter Hebrew Bible / New Testament
Per-stage source and review labels, tailored interpretation cautions, reader and starting-verse Atlas navigation
milestones.verification: Canonical references, profile IDs, source/review metadata and bounded reading ranges are validated in CI. Primary-text checks are AI-assisted and partly limited by source access; independent specialist and source-critical review remain outstanding. No historical reconstruction or complete biography is claimed.

milestones.title: Official Scripture Trails domain launch
milestones.summary: The production website has its own canonical HTTPS address at www.scripturetrails.com, with shared passage links preserved through redirects.
capabilities: Custom production domain and HTTPS canonical address
Permanent apex and HTTP redirects preserving paths and query strings
Canonical/social metadata, robots instructions and sitemap using the official address
milestones.verification: Recorded in release v0.2.11 and the production configuration documentation. This is a completed launch milestone; ongoing domain and deployment availability remains an operational responsibility.

milestones.title: Atlas path tracing and in-place passage preview
milestones.summary: The Atlas now distinguishes the shortest displayed route, directly connected verses and an in-place Bible passage preview.
capabilities: Hover highlights the shortest displayed route to the centre and the separate one-hop neighbourhood
A first node click previews the passage; a second click on that node explicitly recentres the graph
Selected-edition passage retrieval, publisher attribution and required view reporting remain in place
milestones.verification: Recorded in releases v0.9.1, v0.9.4 and v0.10.0, with graph and preview tests. Shortest means within the bounded displayed graph, not every relationship in the underlying archive.

milestones.title: Versioned releases and deployment consistency
milestones.summary: Every public website update has a semantic version, matching public/development release notes and a footer tied to the loaded application.
capabilities: Release command updates version, both changelogs, footer and asset cache keys together
Checks reject duplicate, inconsistent or out-of-order release metadata and website changes without a version increment
Full pull-request comparison checks version advancement while production metadata checks support shallow Cloudflare checkouts
Matching-version release-note loading prevents stale history from replacing the loaded footer version
milestones.verification: Recorded across v0.3.0-v0.3.1, v0.9.2-v0.9.3 and v0.16.1. GitHub checks, the production commit and deployment result must still be verified for every release; validation is never bypassed.

milestones.title: Hebrew Bible geography and Exodus traditions
milestones.summary: The first Hebrew Bible geography collection follows twenty-five selected Exodus and wilderness readings from Egypt to Moab, with fifteen setting records and five source-linked comparison topics.
capabilities: A dedicated searchable page, five reading sections and shareable stage selections
Twenty-five passage-linked readings, fifteen regional or unresolved setting records and links to existing people and place profiles
Five comparisons: Delta cities, the sea crossing, Horeb/Sinai, Kadesh and two date proposals
Seven supporting source records with authorship, scope, access notes and limitations; reader and starting-verse Atlas actions
milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.19.0. Canonical passages, source relationships, profile IDs, selection/filter behaviour and unassigned coordinates/dates are tested. Primary checks are AI-assisted; source access varies and independent specialist review remains pending. No exact Exodus route, summit, burial location or pharaoh is assigned.

milestones.title: Citation coverage and editorial evidence review - first priority batch
milestones.summary: Forty-three source-level assessments cover 18 Gospel issues, 13 place dossiers, four Nehemiah readings and eight passage comparisons, with retained warnings and precise source-access limits.
capabilities: Dated claim-level sources and decisions alongside affected studies and in a downloadable About-page register
Add scoped bibliography for Cana, Nain, Sidon and Caesarea Philippi; retain nine place-source warnings
Close four Nehemiah primary-passage access gaps without claiming a manuscript or translation audit
Clarify eight selected comparisons and correct two related narratives from parallel to thematic labels
milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.20.0 for the declared 43-record batch. AI-assisted editorial assessment, not independent specialist signoff. Unresolved geography, chronology, source access and textual questions remain explicit; other 107 explained pairs and wider source gaps are not newly assessed.

milestones.title: Automated desktop/mobile release coverage
milestones.summary: Repeatable Chromium journeys and accessibility/layout checks protect the main study workspace in GitHub CI.
capabilities: Reader navigation, four editions, outage recovery, Atlas preview/focus, map/list navigation and roadmap filters
Private notebook round trips, explicit conflict replacement, stale drafts and cross-tab write protection, highlights, place links and reading schedules
All twelve views scanned with axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 A/AA rules in dark/light themes at desktop/mobile sizes, plus horizontal overflow checks
Deterministic synthetic passage fixtures; source and browser jobs feed a failing release gate with retained failure traces
milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.24.1: 48 browser scenarios across desktop and mobile Chromium, with automated accessibility findings fixed and keyboard scenarios recorded. Fixtures do not establish publisher service availability. Manual screen-reader, real-device, Safari and Firefox review remains open.

milestones.title: Manual assistive-technology and real-device review
milestones.summary: Complement the automated Chromium release coverage with recorded screen-reader and real-device reviews.
capabilities: Manual screen-reader checks for reading order, control names, announcements, maps and private notebook flows
Real-device and browser checks beyond emulated desktop/mobile Chromium, including Safari and Firefox
Record keyboard and assistive-technology findings, resolve barriers and retain regression coverage
milestones.verification: Open. Automated axe and keyboard scenarios are delivered separately; no complete accessibility certification, manual screen-reader signoff or real-device audit is claimed.

milestones.title: Independent historical, textual and nautical review
milestones.summary: Seek independent specialist assessment of flagged Gospel chronology, Pauline geography and nautical questions, archaeological identifications, person trails and interpretive connection explanations.
capabilities: Use the Gospel issue register, Pauline source notes and Voyage to Rome specialist-review checklist
Review Caesarea embarkation, unpinned/offshore settings, Malta and gazetteer identifications without assuming more precise coordinates
Assess interpretation and textual-context questions in the 115 explained pairs and twenty person trails
Publish reviewer expertise, date, method, bibliography, decisions and remaining disagreements when review occurs
milestones.verification: Research dependency: no independent reviewer has signed off. Completion requires an actual documented specialist review of a declared scope; AI-assisted screening, automated checks and source-link presence cannot supply that signoff.

milestones.title: Broader people, family and event relationships
milestones.summary: Extend the curated people index and its relationships after the delivered twenty-trail library, prioritising figures needed by new geography collections.
capabilities: Publish a bounded list of additional profiles and passage-linked family or event relationships
Preserve identity distinctions, uncertain identifications and scoped external evidence
Connect new profiles to reader, Atlas, trails and places where supported
milestones.verification: Complete each expansion when its declared coverage, relationship targets, canonical passages and source notes are checked. Citation remediation and independent specialist review have separate milestones; twenty existing trails are already delivered.

milestones.title: Twenty creation, shepherd, renewal and mission assessments

capabilities: Read selected creation, shepherd, renewal, Law, mission and salvation passages in their distinct settings
Follow claim-specific citations to fifteen readable named commentaries and publisher passage views
Retain thematic links as themes and the Isaiah 25/Revelation 21 echo as an editorial classification; no new direct-quotation claims

milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.25.0. Twenty new target IDs and canonical contexts are checked against the dated register; each has two primary-passage citations and one scoped named commentary. Confessional readings are attributed. Wider literature, manuscript/translation questions and independent specialist review remain open.

milestones.title: Twenty Old Testament narrative assessments
milestones.summary: Twenty existing Samuel, Kings, Chronicles and Isaiah parallels now have paired reading contexts, source-specific explanations and scoped named commentary.
capabilities: Compare shared narratives while preserving tribute, priestly, dynastic and royal-evaluation differences
Follow two publisher passage citations and one scoped named commentary for each pair; indexed-excerpt access is explicitly marked
Retain all twenty narrative-parallel classifications; distinguish textual overlap from independent historical evidence
See dated assessment coverage of 88 of 115, with commentary or limited publisher-summary support for 56 assessed pairs
milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.26.0. Exact target IDs, canonical contexts, anchor containment, source scopes and derived coverage are checked. Six commentaries by four authors support specific claims; two commentaries had indexed-excerpt access. Fuller literature, manuscript/translation questions and independent specialist review remain open.

milestones.title: Twenty prayer, faith, hope and Hezekiah assessments
milestones.summary: The seventeen remaining New Testament comparisons and three Hezekiah parallels now have selected reading contexts, specific explanations and scoped named commentary.
capabilities: Compare prayer, grace, love, resurrection and renewal while preserving each passage’s distinct setting
Retain differences in Acts retellings and the Hezekiah accounts; identify Revelation’s two anchors as parts of one vision
Follow paired publisher passage views and seventeen named commentaries by sixteen authors
See dated assessment coverage of 108 of 115, with commentary or limited publisher-summary support for 76 assessed pairs
milestones.verification: Delivered in v0.28.0. Declared targets, canonical contexts, anchor containment, unchanged classifications, source scopes and derived coverage are checked. Existing assessments and sources are preserved. Full literature, manuscript/translation questions and independent specialist review remain open.

milestones.title: Further citation remediation and context review
milestones.summary: Five further twenty-connection batches are assessed through v0.28.0; twelve earlier assessments also gained named commentary. Coverage is 108 of 115 pairs, with 7 still outside the dated register. Named commentary or limited publisher-summary support covers 76 assessed pairs, with source scope recorded; assessed does not mean academically certified.
capabilities: Assess the remaining 7 explained pairs in a separately declared batch with claim-specific sources and access limits
Review the newly linked studies in full, compare competing identifications and revisit person-trail access limitations
Compare complete excavation reports and textual apparatuses where access permits; preserve unresolved warnings
milestones.verification: Each declared batch needs checked supporting citations, implemented corrections or retained warnings with stated source-level reasons. Source-link presence does not establish specialist signoff.
